name: lore
description: Lore memory integration: MEMORY.md write guard, session index loader, recall/remember tools, /lore status. Deterministic, local-only, no model calls.

maxLines.title: MEMORY.md max lines
maxLines.description: Maximum number of lines a MEMORY.md index may have.

maxLineChars.title: MEMORY.md max characters per line
maxLineChars.description: Maximum characters on one MEMORY.md line (a hook plus a pointer to a Lore page).

maxBytes.title: MEMORY.md max bytes
maxBytes.description: Maximum size of a MEMORY.md index in bytes (the harness stops loading past about 24,400).

loadIndex.title: Load the MEMORY.md index at session start
loadIndex.description: Inject the cwd's MEMORY.md index and the Lore rules at session start and after clear, resume, fork and compact. Turn on only together with autoMemoryEnabled=false, otherwise Claude Code loads the index a second time.

projectsDir.title: Claude projects directory
projectsDir.description: Absolute path of the Claude Code projects directory that holds <project>/memory/MEMORY.md, for example ~/.claude/projects expanded to a full path.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Absolute path of a Python 3.12+ interpreter that runs lore.py.

lorePy.title: lore.py path
lorePy.description: Absolute path of lore.py as installed by install.sh (<config-dir>/skills/lore/scripts/lore.py).

loreDir.title: Global Lore directory
loreDir.description: Absolute path of your Lore data directory, passed to lore.py as --lore-dir.

accountDirs.title: Claude config directories to report on
accountDirs.description: Claude config directories whose settings.json /lore checks for autoMemoryEnabled=false. Leave empty to skip the check.
